game.description: Fast timed Chekharda plus dispute-resolution reputation: regulars notice disputes and weigh the opposed entrant's public record.

analysis.method: Per-operator linear utility of initial operators from retained protocol facts; paired comparisons share replica seeds and use exact sign tests (ties and unknowns count against both directions) with percentile bootstrap intervals.
cautions: Strategies are a finite declared menu; an equilibrium of this menu is not an equilibrium of the full game.
Utility weights are explicit assumptions; use sweepValuation to locate where conclusions change.
Population best responses compare whole-cohort policies. Individual incentives come from the deviation tests, which hold everyone else fixed.
Payoffs exclude unmodeled consequences (reputation outside the protocol, legal risk, market prices) unless expressed through the declared weights.
